eip712Domain().details: returns the fields and values that describe the domain separator used by this contract for EIP-712 signature.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

quote((address,uint256,bytes),address,ad.details: Method can be executed in a static-call

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.rateBps: annual simple-interest rate in basis points (e.g. 820 = 8.20%)

params.token: The token to rescue, use `IERC20(address(0))` for native ETH.

simulate(address,bytes).details: Simulates a delegatecall to the target address and reverts with the result. This function always reverts, returning the simulation outcome in the error data. Can be used for off-chain simulation to preview transaction effects.

params.data: The calldata to pass to the delegatee.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

AQUA().notice: Aqua protocol instance for balance management

asView().notice: Cast contract to ISwapVM interface for view-only operations

buildAquaLimitLeg(address,address,addres.notice: Generic two-token Aqua limit leg (balance-ratio priced, drifts with fills). Kept for the Test 1 round trip and as the base of the auction leg.

buildFacilityLeg((address,address,addres.notice: Facility open/draw leg: each draw is a zero-in exact-out partial fill of the committed pullToken; `_stopWhenCovered` caps cumulative draws at the facility size.

buildMaturityLeg((address,address,addres.notice: Maturity leg (per draw): zero-in pull of the repayment from the borrower's Aqua balance, gated by maturity time and the settlement executor. `_stopWhenCovered` doubles as double-settlement protection (a second pull hits OrderCovered).

hash((address,uint256,bytes)).notice: Compute unique hash for an order

repaymentAmount(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Zero-coupon repayment for a draw: principal × (1 + rateBps · term / 365d)
